label: AD&D 2nd Edition (quotable law: For Gold & Glory; official scans local-only)

d20_states.note: 2e has no advantage machinery; d20_state modifiers are refused with a note

hp_from_hd.note: monster HD are d8 (FG&G); '12+24' reads 12d8+24; fractional HD mapping is the standard rendering — provisional until FG&G pours

attack.notes: descending AC: you hit AC (THAC0 − roll); nat 20/1 auto rules per FG&G; RAW 2e has no critical damage effect (crit_effect: none)

save.notes: save targets come from the class/HD matrices — law (Mechanus/caller supplies the target number)

ability.notes: roll-under: succeed by rolling your ability score or less

proficiency.notes: nonweapon proficiency: roll-under ability, check modifier adjusts the target

reaction.notes: encounter-reaction banding per the common 2e DMG rendering — confirm against For Gold & Glory when it pours

surprise.notes: 1-3 on d10 = surprised; situational mods are law

initiative.notes: low wins; weapon speed / casting time adds

encounter_doctrine.note: wandering-encounter doctrine; module set-pieces usually skip 'check' and 'table'; morale arms (never pre-rolls)

sources: For Gold & Glory (free retroclone, pending pour)
